properties.name: Reserve and eco-sensitive zones, outer boundary
properties.reliability: Official files joined. Covers the reserve outline above plus both notified eco-sensitive zones, which also take in all nine enclaves inside the Bhainsrorgarh sanctuary file and part of the unmapped 2023 buffer. Going by the Kota block file, at least about 8 km² of the 2023 Akelgarh addition and small parts of Sakatpura and Karondi fall outside; the National Chambal piece and part of the 2023 core villages (the OpenStreetMap point for Kolpura is about 0.5 km outside) may too. The 3.5 km² hole around Jawara Khurd is drawn by the ESZ file, but the Gazette lists Jawara Khurd as an ESZ village.
properties.method: Reserve outer boundary joined with the MHTR ESZ outer-limit file and the Bhainsrorgarh ESZ file. Holes the official files draw are kept (the 3.5 km² exclusion in the MHTR ESZ file); gaps under 0.5 km² where two files' edges miss each other are filled.

properties.disclaimer: Reconstructed from Rajasthan Forest Department map files for reference. Not a legal or cadastral boundary: the reserve is defined by the schedules and boundary descriptions in the notifications. The Forest Department marks its files as for management use, not legal purposes.
properties.gaps: The eco-sensitive zones take in all nine enclaves in the Bhainsrorgarh sanctuary file, most of the 2023 core villages and part of the unmapped 2023 buffer. Some land still falls outside: going by the Kota block file, at least about 8 km² of the 2023 Akelgarh addition and small parts of Sakatpura and Karondi. The National Chambal piece, Ambarani-A and at least one 2023 core village may too (the OpenStreetMap point for Kolpura, 75.4421 E 24.8663 N, lies about 0.5 km outside this outline). The 2020 ESZ was drawn around the 2013 reserve and crosses forest blocks partly added to the buffer in 2023. The 3.5 km² hole around Jawara Khurd is drawn by the ESZ file, but the Gazette's village list names Jawara Khurd as an ESZ village.
